conditional_two_cubic_points_independent.proof: If P1,P2 were dependent, their primitive sum would generate the saturated rank-one subgroup containing them. Write Pi=mi*trace modulo torsion. Their nonzero heights at most4 force mi=+/-1, but m1+m2=1 is impossible. Thus they are independent.

geometric_D6_minimum_height_certificate.why_only_multiplicity_one: A section has intersection1 with the total fiber. Thus it can meet only one multiplicity-one component, not a crossing or a higher-multiplicity component.
